- Saudi Arabia – Red Sea/Persian Gulf (coastal)
- Thailand – Gulf of Thailand/Andaman Sea (coastal)
- United Arab Emirates – Persian Gulf (coastal)

Result: All except Bhutan have access to the sea. Preliminary count = 12 coastal Asian monarchies.
